MR Safety
MR Conditional (1.5 and 3.0 Tesla): SFG ≤ 2,500 gauss/cm (25 T/m); slew rate ≤ 150 T/m/s per axis; B1+rms ≤ 1.2 microtesla; Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1.2 W/kg; Limit total active scanning to 60 min; Use the body transmit coil.
Image artifact: up to 15 mm.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
